_comment: Three tool-capable drivers, one per wire family MJ actually reaches.
Gemini 3.7 Flash — the current Google Flash and the cheapest of the family ($0.75/$3.75,
against $1.50/$9.00 for 3.5 Flash). Google is the only developer measured
so far, so it carries the continuity with the recorded Google sweep.
GPT 4.1-mini    — a non-Google control on the canonical OpenAI wire shape. Pre-reasoning
generation deliberately: the audit's tool-calling quirks cluster in the reasoning models,
so a pre-reasoning row is the baseline those are read against.
GPT-OSS-120B    — the deployed workhorse (all 15 corpus agents list it) on Cerebras, and the
first live exercise of the CerebrasLLM tool mapping. Note this model DOES support tool
calling — envelope-vs-native is a mode axis, not a property of the model.
Anthropic is absent: its key currently 401s. Groq is absent: no key is configured at all.
